description:
Activate Luxior's first equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Teferi.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Teferi, which enters the battlefield with ten loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing nine loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
